name: Bit-stealing for Strand-Based Geometry
definition: A heterogeneous BVH representation for strand-based geometry (hair/fur) that uses AABBs near the tree root for fast traversal and OBBs at deeper levels for tighter volume fits, combining sum types, quantized encoding, and bit-field exploitation.
summary: Bit-stealing for strand-based geometry is a heterogeneous BVH for hair that uses AABBs near the root and OBBs deeper down, distinguished by encoding node type and offsets within a single 64-bit index to reduce memory footprint.
